svg.title: SIM card case study: A/B/C development detection results (actual run output)
svg.desc: Self-contained SVG 1.1 figure. Process geometry is used unchanged from the bpmndi:BPMNDiagram of sim_original_flattened.bpmn; every callout annotation is derived from the run capsule of sim_case_c1_run_v1 (rows / comparison / repairs / summary).
svg.text: SIM 卡入网案例：A/B/C 三组开发性检测结果（实际输出）
开发性案例研究（development case study；claim_scope = development_case_study_not_formal_gold）：非作者原始实验，非正式 Gold；图中全部标注取自本次运行的实际输出。
分数来自冻结的 Sun 风格检查：gamma = 0.8 / gamma_ext = 0.5，基于无词向量的 spaCy small 模型（vector-less spaCy small）。

A 组：non-LLM deterministic adapter + frozen Sun-style three-type detection ｜ B 组：real-LLM predictions (repeat-01) + SAME three-type detection as A ｜ C 组：SAME stage2 and three-type rows as B + four extended types
运行汇总（checks / 违规 / 无法判断 / 满足）：A 15 / 5 / 9 / 1 ｜ B 15 / 5 / 8 / 2 ｜ C 35 / 8 / 25 / 2；5 个修复探针 problem_removed 均为 false
流程：sim_original_flattened.bpmn（图形与坐标原样取自 bpmndi:BPMNDiagram，未改动、未新增节点）
非原模型节点（虚线占位）
该活动在模型中不存在
